summary: Vopak is dutch multinational company, founded in 1999. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 67% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding; 5 about acquisitions; 1 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: Rotterdam tank-storage company with over 400 years of history, now building infrastructure for hydrogen, ammonia and CO₂; mostly senior roles.

culture.text: Stores oil, gas, chemicals and edible oils in tank terminals at ports worldwide; about 4,224 people on LinkedIn.
Staff mostly come from Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences, TU Delft and Erasmus, studying business, mechanical and chemical engineering.

open.text: IND recognised visa sponsor (Koninklijke Vopak, Vopak Global IT and Vopak LNG Holding).

growth.text: Vopak and Gasunie put a fourth LNG tank at the Gate terminal into use.
Is developing infrastructure for hydrogen, ammonia, CO₂, long-duration energy storage and low-carbon feedstocks.
